name: 54534 · Hurley, WI
findings: ZIP 54534 (Hurley) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54534 (Hurley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54534 (Hurley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
